hello.speaker: gate_guard
hello.text: East road is open, if you can call it that. It goes to the Barrow and nowhere else, these days.

choices.text: What have you seen out there?

seen.speaker: gate_guard
seen.text: Green lights, most nights. And once a man walking up the road who I helped bury last winter. I did not call out.

goblins.speaker: gate_guard
goblins.text: Goblins in the old orchard, behind the hedge there. Captain says leave them be while the Barrow is glowing. Tova at the smithy says otherwise, loudly.

after.speaker: gate_guard
after.text: No lights last night. First time in a month. Whatever you did, do you want a drink?
